title: Aldrin Justice
cn: 第28集 · 奥尔德林正义
novel:
Lily got a [[temporary|temporary]] job at Ted's architecture [[firm|firm]]. But she was a [[kindergarten|kindergarten]] teacher, not an [[office|office]] worker — and she brought her classroom [[philosophy|philosophy]] with her. She called it "Aldrin Justice": when someone [[misbehaved|misbehave]], she would [[confiscate|confiscate]] something they loved.

First, she took the boss's [[expensive|expense]] [[pen|pen]] because he was [[rude|rude]] to the [[intern|intern]]. Then she took a [[developer|developer]]'s prized baseball because he [[yelled|yell]] at a [[secretary|secretary]]. Ted was [[horrified|horrify]] — this was his [[career|career]] she was [[messing|mess]] with!

But strange things started happening. The boss, missing his pen, actually started [[listening|listen]] to his [[employees|employee]]. The developer, without his baseball, became [[noticeably|noticeable]] calmer. "Your [[girlfriend|girlfriend]] is a [[genius|genius]]," one [[colleague|colleague]] told Ted.

"She's not my girlfriend," Ted said. "She's my best friend's ex-[[fiancee|fiancee]]."

Lily's justice system [[culminated|culminate]] when she took something from the [[CEO|CEO]] himself — a signed [[photograph|photograph]] of him with a famous architect. The CEO was [[furious|furious]]... until he realized he had been treating his [[staff|staff]] terribly. He called a meeting and actually [[apologized|apologize]].

"See?" Lily told Ted. "Kindergarten rules work everywhere."

temporary.en: lasting for only a short time, not permanent

kindergarten.en: a school for very young children

office.en: a room or building where people work at desks

philosophy.en: a system of beliefs or ideas about how to live or work

confiscate.en: to take something away from someone as a punishment

expense.en: the money you spend on something

pen.en: a tool used for writing with ink

rude.en: not polite; speaking or behaving in a way that hurts others

intern.en: someone who works for a short time to learn a job

developer.en: a company or person that builds or creates something

yell.en: to shout loudly, especially when angry

secretary.en: a person who helps with office work like typing and organizing

career.en: a job or profession you do for a long part of your life

mess with.en: to interfere with something or cause trouble for someone

listen.en: to pay attention to someone's words

employee.en: a person who works for a company or organization

noticeably.en: in a way that is easy to see or notice

genius.en: someone with an unusually high level of intelligence or skill

colleague.en: a person you work with in the same place

fiancee.en: a woman who is engaged to be married

CEO.en: the highest-ranking person in a company

photograph.en: a picture made using a camera

staff.en: all the people who work for a company

apologize.en: to say sorry for something you did wrong
